design.scope_reason: The host ranks supplied candidates exactly; fit explanations must distinguish verified criteria from unresolved information.
design.draft_instructions: Explain the supplied accounts using the host scores, explicit weights and exclusions. Preserve every candidate ID and exclusion. Separate confirmed fit from unknown criteria and identify a useful next research question for unresolved fit. Do not fabricate accounts, contacts, buying intent or win probabilities.
design.review_instructions: Check explanations against each original account and the host ranking. Excluded candidates must not be recommended, unknown criteria must not become confirmed fit, and a score must not be presented as a buying probability. Preserve missing information without requesting speculative enrichment.

templates.title: Research an account before a meeting
templates.job: Enter a customer conversation with verified context and useful questions.
templates.inputs: Company identity; supplied company/CRM notes; attendees and meeting goal; source dates; optional verified read adapter.
templates.execution: Resolve company → collect bounded evidence → map known people/context → synthesize meeting brief → verify
templates.acceptance: Company identity unambiguous; facts dated/cited; unknown roles explicit; discussion hypotheses labeled.
templates.failure: Paywall/unavailable source is a gap; stale research cannot masquerade as current news; no invented personal details.
templates.implementation_delta: New job; a one-page briefing plus source-backed stakeholder context, not an unbounded web essay.
templates.illustrative_example: Supplied notes show open integration questions; brief includes the exact unanswered decision criteria.

sample.goal: Enter a customer conversation with verified context and useful questions.

templates.title: Build a grounded outreach campaign
templates.job: Prepare relevant outreach variants from approved account evidence.
templates.inputs: Approved target list; offer and factual claims; audience; tone; channel constraints; exclusions/contact permissions.
templates.execution: Check eligibility → map account evidence to offer → draft sequence → verify claims/constraints → queue
templates.acceptance: Every personalization supported; exclusions honored; no fabricated familiarity; channel limits and CTA checked.
templates.failure: Insufficient account evidence yields a generic clearly labeled variant or a held row; no invented emails.
templates.implementation_delta: New job; evidence-backed batch drafts with human review and explicit no-send default; delivery is a separate adapter.
templates.illustrative_example: One account's documented integration need informs a draft; an unsupported funding claim is omitted.

templates.title: Turn discovery notes into a deal plan
templates.job: Convert a call into confirmed needs, missing decisions and next actions.
templates.inputs: Transcript/notes; account ID; meeting date; sales process; approved product facts; follow-up format.
templates.execution: Validate supplied input → draft from the immutable snapshot → review against original sources → host checks before delivery → one correction if needed.
templates.acceptance: Commitments quote/link to source; owners/dates not invented; proposals distinguished from agreements; all critical unknowns shown.
templates.failure: Unclear speaker/budget/timeline stays unknown; unsupported promise blocks ready-to-send status.
templates.implementation_delta: New job; structured deal knowledge and an actionable follow-up bundle, not just a call summary.
templates.illustrative_example: A suggested $20k budget is marked unconfirmed; a promised technical follow-up becomes a sourced action.

design.scope_reason: Follow-up planning must distinguish transcript facts from suggestions and avoid manufacturing commitments.
design.draft_instructions: Extract confirmed needs, open questions and known stakeholders from the supplied notes, then propose a short actionable follow-up plan. Tie confirmed statements to original passages. Distinguish an explicit commitment from a suggestion; unknown budget, owner and date stay unknown. Make proposed next actions clearly provisional.
design.review_instructions: Check needs, stakeholder roles and commitments against the original notes. Reject inferred approval, invented budget, or a proposed owner/date presented as confirmed. Check that next actions address the unresolved questions and are labeled as suggestions when no agreement exists.

templates.title: Find and qualify business partners
templates.persona: Business development lead; founder; agency owner
templates.job: Select candidate partners with an explicit mutual-value thesis.
templates.inputs: Candidate organizations/evidence; partner type; objectives; exclusions; capability requirements; scoring criteria.
templates.execution: Normalize candidates → map complementarity → apply eligibility rules → develop mutual-value cases → challenge ranking
templates.acceptance: Partner claims sourced; conflicts/exclusions checked; score components visible; commercial assumptions labeled.
templates.failure: Missing candidate evidence yields research gaps; unknown willingness to partner is never asserted.
templates.implementation_delta: New job; supplied candidates first, optional bounded sourcing later; resellers/integrators/referral partners are presets.

templates.title: Build a market-entry decision pack
templates.job: Choose a segment, positioning and testable entry plan from evidence.
templates.inputs: Decision question; candidate markets; criteria; constraints; dated sources; competitor evidence; assumptions.
templates.execution: Frame alternatives → extract comparable evidence → score explicit criteria → challenge assumptions → propose entry experiment
templates.acceptance: Comparable units/periods; cited competitor claims; uncertainty visible; scenario arithmetic exact; no unsupported market-size total.
templates.failure: Insufficient market evidence produces a research/experiment plan; unsupported live-market claims withheld.
templates.implementation_delta: New job; decision criteria, scenario table and an actionable experiment distinguish it from general source research #9.
templates.illustrative_example: Two fictional segments are compared on distribution access and fit; an uncertain demand assumption becomes an experiment.
